title: Not well made
text: Not well made. I've owned these before and I really like them. These however, were NOT well made. I returned them and many weeks after I was recharged for both sets of them. I produced the receipt stating the tracking number and all other information and still haven't been credited back or even heard from this seller. I would not ever purchase from this seller again.
